podcast.title: Interview on "Jesus Is Just Alright" Intentions
podcast.body: Tom Johnston of The Doobie Brothers stated in an interview with Carl Weiser for Songfacts that he had "no idea who AR Reynolds is" and that the band had no intention of recording a gospel song with their cover of "Jesus Is Just Alright." He noted their surprise at the strong religious reaction from fans, dubbed "one-wayers," at their shows. "Tom said that he still has no idea who AR Reynolds is and incorrectly stated that the birds released a recording of the song first, all of which is to confirm that there was no intention on the part of the Dubie Brothers to record a gospel song."
